listing.name: [WIP] Europa Federation
listing.summary: Adds a faction pack containing a faction with ships, weapons and strikecraft, along with two new star systems.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a faction pack containing a faction with ships, weapons and strikecraft, along with two new star systems.

description: Adds the Europa Federation faction, which prefers energy weapons and emphasizes point defence. Includes two new star systems, Europa and Carthage, located in the south of the sector. Also provides a separate download for ships and weapons only.
